topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: People always got a story, and it don't always jive with the facts. Found out my buddy's been spinning tales about where he hangs his hat. Figured as much, sooner or later. The world don't favor the straight shooters, not in the long run. Lying's a way of life out here, a survival game. Question is, what's he trying to survive? Not asking me straight, so I ain't gonna press him in the open. Gonna watch, listen, maybe get a handle on what the real job might be. It's the why that gets you in the end, not the how.
